assuranceClaims.standardRef: GDPR/privacy-by-design context; no general compliance claim
limitations: Not a DPIA, DPO opinion, legal assessment, or formal GDPR certification.

assuranceClaims.scope: Control Center and ecosystem product work target accessible interaction and WCAG-oriented review gates.
limitations: Target and review model documented; coverage is not universal certification.
Each surface requires evidence bound to the tested version.

assuranceClaims.scope: Human-validation, responsive/mobile/LIM and perceptible-write quality signals.
limitations: Product-specific evidence must be collected and version-bound.

assuranceClaims.scope: Security assurance signals may include automated gates and ASVS-oriented checks when evidenced by product/release.
limitations: No ecosystem-wide security certification is asserted.
Coverage must be established per product/version.

assuranceClaims.scope: Normative sources, domain governance and institutional responsibility remain distinct assurance layers.
limitations: Presence of a normative source is not legal validation of the whole product.

limitations: No formal certification is recorded by this registry entry.
